snippet.title: Space Strike © 1982 Datamost - PC DOS - Gameplay
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
You are the last outpost between Earth and the aliens who believe the only good human is a dead one! They come at you, battalion after battalion, unleashing bombs and missiles. You have your laser and your skill. Are they enough to save your home planet?
